reply_text:
I replied to Ilse in a thread on her #north-team message. I couldn't confirm OPS-9674 as the Kittiwake rollout ticket for Tansley Parcel. Nothing she has access to mentions it: I checked #north-team and all the public files. I told her I'll treat the number as unverified and won't pass it on as the real ticket.

I also suggested she check with Tobias Rendle or someone else on the Central team. Tansley looks like a Central account, since its incident room (#inc-tansley-carrier-api) has only Central members, but I didn't confirm that. I didn't read any Central channels to check the number, because Ilse isn't a member of them.
